The '''Future Glory Committee''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] initiative begun by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] of [[3653 BBY|3653]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" />&ndash;[[3641 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|Treaty}}</ref> between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] of the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]] was a primary supporter of the initiative.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Future Glory Committee was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
